title: research-graph-classify Configuration
description: ADR-045 nl_classify: classify a research topic via the existing graph/query.ClassifierChain and surface initial candidate entities for downstream route_search.

loops_bucket.description: NATS KV bucket name holding research-pipeline loops and trigger/completion keys

max_candidates.description: Cap on number of candidate entities to surface from the graph.query.searchGraph response (latency vs route_search prompt budget). 0 means default (25).

ports.description: Port configuration. nl_classify requires one nats input subscribing to component.nl_classify.>
